# Styling source
2020-era YouTube clone by Manikandan Raji (MIT). The local adaptation uses its dark theme palette with original Sprout layout CSS. No external fonts, scripts, images, or trackers are loaded.
Source: https://github.com/manikandanraji/youtubeclone-frontend/blob/master/src/styles/GlobalStyle.js
Theme: https://github.com/manikandanraji/youtubeclone-frontend/blob/master/src/styles/theme.js
Not official YouTube CSS. The repository was created in 2020; its default branch also contains later changes.
